intro: Benihana is the famous Japanese teppanyaki steakhouse where chefs cook your meal on a hibachi grill right at the table, complete with the knife tricks, onion volcano and flying shrimp. Hibachi dinners come with soup, salad, vegetables and rice, and the menu also runs a full sushi program, appetizers and combination feasts. Below is the full Benihana menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Benihana, hibachi chicken is about $40.50, hibachi steak $46, and filet mignon $49, each cooked tableside with soup, salad, vegetables and rice. Combinations like Steak & Shrimp ($56) and the Hibachi Supreme ($73) feed bigger appetites, sushi rolls run $10 to $23, and kids hibachi meals start around $27. It is an upscale tableside teppanyaki experience.
hot_deal: Benihana value: hibachi chicken ($40.50) is the entry point and still includes the full show plus soup, salad, vegetables and rice, which makes it better value than it first looks. The Benihana Rewards program (the Chef's Table) gives a birthday reward and a joining bonus. Lunch, where available, is cheaper than dinner. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is dinner at Benihana?
faqs.a: Hibachi entrees run about $40.50 for chicken, $46 for steak and $49 for filet mignon, each including soup, salad, vegetables and rice cooked tableside. Combinations like Steak & Shrimp ($56) and the Hibachi Supreme ($73) cost more. With appetizers and drinks, a dinner for two is a higher-end bill.

faqs.q: What is included with a Benihana hibachi entree?
faqs.a: Each hibachi teppanyaki entree includes Benihana onion soup, a salad with ginger dressing, hibachi vegetables, and steamed rice, all cooked and served at the table as part of the show. Fried rice is usually an upgrade.

Yes. Alongside the hibachi grill, Benihana has a full sushi menu: specialty rolls from about $10 to $23 (California $12.70, Dragon $22.10), plus nigiri, sashimi and combination platters. You can order sushi with or instead of a hibachi entree.

faqs.q: How many calories are in Benihana food?
faqs.a: Benihana does not publish a full calorie guide, so calories are not listed here rather than guessed. Hibachi meals vary with the protein, the oils and sauces used tableside, and whether you add fried rice, so totals differ dish to dish.

faqs.q: What are the most popular dishes at Benihana?
faqs.a: Favorites include hibachi chicken, filet mignon, the Steak & Shrimp combination, the California roll, and the Benihana salad with ginger dressing. The tableside chef show is the real draw.
